text.aria-label: Title text 'Example week in January: KEZ and GK day-ahead forecasts against observation'

g.text: Example week in January: KEZ and GK day-ahead forecasts against observation

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Day-ahead (D+1) forecasts chained from each 09:00 UTC origin over the week starting 12 January 2026, fixed in advance as the second Monday of the month. Black: observed. Orange: KEZ median, with 80% and 90% bands. Dashed blue: GK median. A gap is a day with no scored row (no reading, or inside a switching event).'
text.tspan: Day-ahead (D+1) forecasts chained from each 09:00 UTC origin over the week starting 12 January 2026, fixed in
advance as the second Monday of the month. Black: observed. Orange: KEZ median, with 80% and 90% bands. Dashed
blue: GK median. A gap is a day with no scored row (no reading, or inside a switching event).
